targets.rawSql: SELECT timestamp AS time, fitness AS value, 'Fitness' AS metric FROM daily_recovery WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND fitness IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT timestamp AS time, fatigue AS value, 'Fatigue' AS metric FROM daily_recovery WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND fatigue IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT timestamp AS time, form AS value, 'Form' AS metric FROM daily_recovery WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND form IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time

panels.description: Cumulative workouts by year, aligned by month/day so zooming to a month compares that month across years.

targets.rawSql: WITH bounds AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM now())::int AS comparison_year), years AS (SELECT DISTINCT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM timestamp)::int AS workout_year FROM workouts), calendar AS (SELECT y.workout_year, day::date AS workout_day FROM years y CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(make_date(y.workout_year, 1, 1), CASE WHEN y.workout_year = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM now())::int THEN CURRENT_DATE ELSE make_date(y.workout_year, 12, 31) END, INTERVAL '1 day') day WHERE NOT (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM day) = 2 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM day) = 29)), daily AS (SELECT timestamp::date AS workout_day, COUNT(*)::float AS value FROM workouts GROUP BY 1), cumulative AS (SELECT c.workout_year, c.workout_day, SUM(COALESCE(d.value, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.workout_year ORDER BY c.workout_day) AS value FROM calendar c LEFT JOIN daily d ON d.workout_day = c.workout_day), aligned AS (SELECT make_timestamptz((SELECT comparison_year FROM bounds), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM workout_day)::int, EXTRACT(DAY FROM workout_day)::int, 0, 0, 0) AS time, value, workout_year::text AS metric FROM cumulative) SELECT time, value, metric FROM aligned WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time, metric
